defaultSource: Per-chemical median of the 117 final A2 ww_concentration_nM values in the frozen Step4 city table, in nM. This is the WW input actually used for reference translation; original observed cells remain identifiable. Defaults exist only for NT52. Step2 values can differ at floating-point serialization precision.

units.fhlb: IFSQSAR reference-fish whole-body biotransformation half-life descriptor (source scale)
units.rep: dimensionless molar potency relative to narciclasine

notes: 663, 472 and 52 describe different roles, not a nested training-selection funnel.
descriptorImputed flags missing raw IFSQSAR inputs; null values have not been replaced in the catalogue. The saved model imputer supplies training medians during calculation.
Category labels can be source-provided, LLM-assigned or manually overridden; categorySource records this provenance.
A positive REP on creatinine does not make it a selectable NT52 target.
Predictions for a median-input scenario are not the median of the 117 city-specific predictions; custom results must be separated from manuscript reference statistics.
